## Summary
IT Support Specialist and infrastructure engineering student supporting 60+ endpoints across hybrid business environments (BETA PREP, Bestof Floor LTD, Payment Source). Experienced in Windows 10/11 administration, Active Directory user management, Microsoft 365 support, endpoint configuration, and network troubleshooting (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN).

## Technical Core
- Operating Systems: Windows 10/11, Ubuntu Linux, Windows Server
- Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLAN Segmentation, Subnetting, Routing (CompTIA Network+, Cisco CCNA preparation)
- Virtualization: Hyper-V, VMware ESXi (Nested virtualization, virtual switches)
- Identity & Policy: Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), Group Policy Objects (GPO), RBAC
- Storage: SAN, iSCSI initiator/target, RAID redundancy, Failover Clustering (SMB, VHD Set)
- Software Development: TypeScript, Next.js, Astro, Tailwind CSS

## Software Projects

- CertForge: Open-source IT certification study platform built around CompTIA Network+ and Cisco CCNA exam preparation drills (GitHub: https://github.com/gungortarik/certforge).
